response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_price, AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM m CROSS JOIN a WHERE m.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: Byte rate per media type is SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) over all of its tracks, computed with decimal (non-integer) division. NULL Bytes values are ignored in the sum, while Milliseconds is summed over every track.
Only media types that have at least one track are considered, since the grouping is done on Track. A media type whose rate is NULL is left out of the cross-type average and the filter.
